title: The God of Harvest Praise
description: The God of Harvest Praise in Tonic Solfa to MALVERN (GWYLLT), doh is Bb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: James Montgomery wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 876 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Thanksgiving Hymn”.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sixes and Fours (6.6.4.6.6.6.4), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to MALVERN (GWYLLT); any other Sixes and Fours tune fits them as well.
underlay: The God of har-vest praise; In loud thanks-giv-ings raise Hand, heart, and voice; The val-leys smile and sing, Fo-rests and moun-tains ring, The plains their tri-bute bring, The streams re-joice.
licence: Public domain: James Montgomery died in 1854.
credits: Words by James Montgomery (1771–1854), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to MALVERN (GWYLLT) by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
